page.title: Updates
page.lead: Installed version, new release checks and a safe update: backup, images, migrations, health check and automatic rollback.

status.loadFailed: Could not load the update state.

last.failed: The update to {{to}} ({{at}}) failed and the rollback did not finish. Manual action is needed.
last.rolled_back: The update to {{to}} ({{at}}) failed. The system went back to the previous version.

banner.manual: The update executor is not connected
banner.manualBody: The Studio checks releases and notifies you, the operator installs with the command below: that is how Helm works (rollback with `--atomic`); for compose enable the updater service: `docker compose --profile updater up -d` with UPDATER_TOKEN in .env.
banner.updaterOffline: The updater service does not answer
banner.updaterOfflineBody: Automatic installs and the update buttons do not work until it runs: `docker compose up -d updater`. Release checks and notifications still work.
banner.noBackupBody: Before an update the updater takes only a database snapshot. A full backup (files and objects) is possible once the Backups section has a destination.
banner.checkFailed: Could not ask for the release list

version.title: Version
version.lead: What is installed, what is out and when the system installs it by itself.
version.noDigest: This release publishes no image digest: a verified update will not pass. Turn image verification off in the policy or wait for the next release.

policy.title: Policy and window
policy.lead: How the system learns about releases and whether it installs them. Window times are UTC. The window applies to automatic installs.

hint.off: Releases are not checked, no notifications.
hint.notify: We check the stable channel and notify admins; you install with the button.
hint.auto: We install by ourselves in the maintenance window, with a backup and automatic rollback.

bump.label: Largest step without a human
bump.hint: Anything bigger (for example a new major version) is notify-only.

backup.label: Full backup before updating
backup.hint: When Backups has a destination, the update waits for its successful backup. The updater always takes a database snapshot.

hint.digest: The pulled image digest must equal the one published with the release.
hint.cosign: Also checks the cosign signature (GitHub OIDC) of the publish workflow.
hint.none: Only for closed mirrors and forks: a swapped image goes unnoticed.

history.title: History
history.lead: Updates and rollbacks with their outcome. The step-by-step log opens with the Log button.

confirmUpdate.title: Update to {{version}}?
confirmUpdate.body: The updater takes a database snapshot, pulls and verifies the image, applies migrations and restarts the services. If the new version does not come up, the system goes back by itself.
confirmUpdate.downtime: The Studio is unavailable during migrations and restart, usually 1-3 minutes. Running builds are interrupted.

confirmRollback.title: Roll back to {{version}}?
confirmRollback.body: We bring back the images of the previous version.
confirmRollback.dataLoss: The update changed the database schema, so the rollback restores the snapshot taken before it. Everything written after the update is lost.
confirmRollback.noDataLoss: The database schema did not change: data stays as is.

failure.executor_unavailable: The built-in executor is off: update with the operator command.
failure.updater_offline: The updater does not answer: start the updater service.
failure.unknown_version: This version is not in the release list.
failure.not_cancellable: The updater has already taken the run.
failure.rate_limited: Too many requests, try again later.
failure.unknown: Something went wrong. Try again later.
